# Shadecode Student

> AI-powered learning platform for students. Study smarter. Live sharper.

## Public resources

- [Home](https://shadecodestudent.vercel.app/)
- [Privacy Policy](https://shadecodestudent.vercel.app/privacy.html)
- [Terms of Service](https://shadecodestudent.vercel.app/terms.html)
- [Security](https://shadecodestudent.vercel.app/security.html)

## Product

Shadecode Student provides study planning, learning, practice, examination simulation, mathematics assistance, analytics, gamification, and optional AI-assisted learning features. The product is designed with local-first and offline-capable operation as a core direction.

## AI output

AI-generated content is educational assistance, not authoritative examination guidance. Users should verify important academic information against their syllabus, teachers, textbooks, and official examination materials.
